intended_behavior: Move the invocation of BeforeInvocationEvent hook to occur after the construction of temp_messages (combined messages and prompt). Modify the BeforeInvocationEvent call to include temp_messages as a parameter, allowing hook handlers to inspect and modify the complete input before further processing.

Modify the BeforeInvocationEvent hook invocation to include the input messages parameter, so that hooks have visibility into the incoming messages before they are appended to the agent's message list or processed further.

Extend the BeforeInvocationEvent class to accept an additional parameter for the input messages received during agent invocation. This allows hooks receiving the event to access and possibly modify the messages before the invocation proceeds. Ensure this new parameter is optional or backward compatible to avoid breaking existing hook implementations.
